translation: He also said: For mania-epilepsy that occurs by day, moxa the Yang Qiao; for [that which occurs] by night, moxa the Yin Qiao. The Lumbago Theory of the Su wen says: For lumbar pain where one cannot raise [the body], Shenmai and Pucan raise it. (The points of Taiyang, the root of the Yang Qiao.) It also says: The vessel of Huiyin makes a person suffer lumbar pain, with dripping sweat welling up on the pain; when the sweat dries it makes one want to drink, and after drinking one wants to run about. Puncture the vessel of the straight-yang (Zhiyang) above with three points.
